surfaceDeclaration: Mixed: asphalt (code 1) on the asphalt segments' 13 m road width; kerb (code 2: paved, asphalt coefficients, flat) on a 1.1 m band inside the asphalt corners' apex half; gravel (code 0) on gravel segments, all other runoff and terrain. Surface codes are per 1 m grid vertex (nearest), so band edges are quantized to about 0.5 m. Coefficients are the v5 core's declared design priors (V5Surface), not measured. The five technique gates were run on uniform gravel only; nothing on this course is a gate result.

terrain.note: Road and runoff are exact (road function) out to the runoff edge or, where another part of the track is near, 2.5 m short of the midway line. All other ground is a membrane fill (smooth surface pulled toward a gently undulating target from distance-weighted route heights). The rendered grass is drawn visualDropM below the physical ground so the road and runoff ribbons always cover it.

grid.format: RXG1: int32 nx, nz; float32 x0, z0, step; float32 heights[nz][nx]; uint8 surface[nz][nx]; little-endian
grid.triangles: cell (i,j): (v00, v01, v11) and (v00, v11, v10); v01 is +z

sectors.name: S1
sectors.note: start, T1 braking zone, paddock straight, T2/T3 flick

sectors.name: S2
sectors.note: hill climb, T4 crest sweeper, descent, T5, compression

sectors.name: S3
sectors.note: T6 hairpin, T7 onto asphalt, T8, back straight to the line
